ESG 1-to-1 – legacy flow packages

Use this only if Solutions can't be imported in your environment (no Dataverse). It writes your site address and email into the eight flows and saves eight .zip packages for My flows → Import → Import Package (Legacy). It works offline; nothing leaves this page.

The full address of the private 1-to-1 site, without a trailing slash.
Receives submissions, problem reports and the setup summary.
    Then, for each package (0 to 5, in order):
    1. Power Automate → My flows → Import → Import Package (Legacy) → upload the zip.
    2. Under Related resources, click each connection and pick (or create) your own SharePoint / Outlook / Office 365 Users connection.
    3. Click Import. Run flow 0 once, then turn on flows 1, 2 and 3 (see 04-solution/IMPORT_GUIDE.md).
